created_for: Hays Grass ID Lab — source-by-character crosschecking
policy: Independent citations are confirmed only for the exact claim and character stated. Do not use these records to mutate scored trait states; flag different terminology and taxonomic interpretations. Printed book page, excerpt-PDF page, or exact online section are mandatory when known. Range and county nativity deliberately excluded.
